content.short: Denarii Labs is a Web3 tokenomics accelerator from Horizen Lab Ventures and Red Beard Ventures.
content.description: Founded in 2023, Denarii Labs supports the next generation of Web3 ventures by guiding founders to design robust tokenomics. Drawing on the insights of a seasoned roster of in-house advisors, partners, and a broad network of investors, the program combines hands-on mentorship with rigorous evaluation. Its selective due diligence identifies promising early-stage projects and nurtures them, signaling quality and confidence to the market. By aligning founders with experienced mentors and a disciplined investor network, Denarii Labs aims to accelerate viable projects toward meaningful market wins.
